newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Government says Guatemala ambassador still a hostage.
newsitem.headline: Government says Guatemala ambassador still a hostage.

text.p: Guatemala's ambassador to Peru is still a hostage of Marxist rebels in Lima, despite reports he was among 225 people liberated Sunday night, an official said on Tuesday.
"The Foreign Affairs Ministry has not been able to contact him and he has not contacted us," Ministry spokesman Antonio Monzon told Reuters.

Ambassador Jose Maria Argueta's name was on an official Red Cross list of 225 hostages to be released. But the Red Cross said on Monday that the names of seven of the men freed from the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima did not match those on the list.

Guatemalan Foreign Affairs Minister Eduardo Stein told El Grafico newspaper Argueta was among approximately 140 people still being held by rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement who stormed the ambassador's residence one week ago.
